## Microsoft Security Logging Guide: Ingestion Health and Table Freshness

Monitors whether documented Microsoft Sentinel Analytics tables are landing, tracks connector health in `SentinelHealth`, audits rule changes in `SentinelAudit`, and surfaces stale watchlists. Built from `queries/validation/` and `docs/sentinel-health.md`.

content.query:
// Master validation query: is every documented Sentinel table landing?
// Checks freshness, 24h/7d row counts and 7-day volume across every Analytics-tier table in the guide.
// Run in: Defender portal > Investigation & response > Advanced hunting (Sentinel workspace selected) or Log Analytics Logs.
// Trim ExpectedTables to the connectors you actually use before turning this into a scheduled alert rule.
// Note: Tables set to Data lake tier only do not appear in workspace Analytics unions; inspect them in Data lake explorer.
let ExpectedTables = datatable(Table: string, Group: string, MaxSilentHours: int) [
    "AADManagedIdentitySignInLogs", "identity", 24,
    "AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs", "identity", 1,
    "AADProvisioningLogs", "identity", 24,
    "AADRiskyServicePrincipals", "identity", 168,

    DeviceFileEvents,
    DeviceLogonEvents,
    DeviceNetworkEvents,
    DeviceProcessEvents,
    EmailAttachmentInfo,
    EmailEvents,
    EmailPostDeliveryEvents,
    EmailUrlInfo,
    Event,
    FinanceOperationsActivity_CL,
    FunctionAppLogs,
    GCPAuditLogs,
    GCPDNS,
    GCPVPCFlow,
    GitHubAdvancedSecurityAlerts_CL,
    GitHubAuditLogsV2_CL,
    GitHubAuditLogsV3_CL,
    GoogleCloudSCC,
    IdentityInfo,
    IntuneAuditLogs,
    IntuneDeviceComplianceOrg,
    IntuneDevices,
    IntuneOperationalLogs,
    LAQueryLogs,
    MDCFileIntegrityMonitoringEvents,
    McasShadowItReporting,
    MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs,
    MicrosoftPurviewInformationProtection,
    NTANetAnalytics,
    NetworkAccessTraffic,
    OfficeActivity,
    PowerAutomateActivity,
    PowerPlatformAdminActivity,
    RemoteNetworkHealthLogs,
    SecureScores,
    SecurityAlert,
    SecurityEvent,
    SecurityIncident,
    SecurityRecommendation,
    SecurityRegulatoryCompliance,
    SentinelAudit,
    SentinelHealth,
    SigninLogs,
    StorageBlobLogs,
    StorageFileLogs,
    StorageQueueLogs,
    StorageTableLogs,
    Syslog,
    UrlClickEvents,
    W3CIISLog,
    WindowsEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | summarize Rows24h = countif(TimeGenerated > ago(24h)), Rows7d = count(), Latest = max(TimeGenerated) by Table;
let Volume = Usage
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | summarize GB7d = round(sum(Quantity) / 1000.0, 3), DailyAvgGB = round(sum(Quantity) / 1000.0 / 7.0, 3), IsBillable = any(IsBillable) by Table = DataType;
ExpectedTables
| join kind=leftouter Freshness on Table
| join kind=leftouter Volume on Table
| extend
    Rows24h = coalesce(Rows24h, 0),
    Rows7d = coalesce(Rows7d, 0),
    AgeHours = iff(isnotempty(Latest), round((now() - Latest) / 1h, 1), real(null)),
    GB7d = coalesce(GB7d, 0.0),
    DailyAvgGB = coalesce(DailyAvgGB, 0.0)
| extend Status = case(
    Rows7d == 0, "NO_DATA_7D",
    AgeHours > MaxSilentHours, "STALE",
    "OK"
)
| project Group, Table, Status, Rows24h, Rows7d, Latest, AgeHours, MaxSilentHours, DailyAvgGB, GB7d, IsBillable
| order by Status asc, Group asc, Table asc
content.title: All documented Sentinel tables: freshness and 7-day volume

content.query:
SentinelHealth
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where SentinelResourceType == 'DataConnector'
| summarize Events = count(), Failures = countif(Status == 'Failure'), Latest = arg_max(TimeGenerated, Status)
    by Connector = SentinelResourceName
| order by Failures desc
content.title: SentinelHealth: data connector status and failures (7 days)

content.query:
SentinelAudit
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where SentinelResourceType == 'AlertRule'
| where OperationName has_any ('Delete', 'Disable', 'Update')
| project TimeGenerated, Rule = SentinelResourceName, OperationName, Description
| order by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: SentinelAudit: analytics rule changes (14 days)

content.query:
Watchlist
| where TimeGenerated > ago(60d)
| summarize Items = count(), LastUpdate = max(LastUpdatedTimeUTC) by WatchlistAlias
| extend DaysSinceUpdate = round((now() - LastUpdate) / 1d, 1)
| order by DaysSinceUpdate desc
content.title: Watchlist staleness check (60 days)
